Subject: Marketplace listing — VAT & PO questions

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement had a couple of follow-ups before we can sign the PO and complete the AWS Marketplace listing:

1) We are an EU-registered company (Netherlands). Procurement wants confirmation whether Redwood will invoice AsterCloud directly or through the AWS marketplace billing flow for SaaS listings. That impacts whether we need to supply a VAT-exempt invoice or a standard VAT invoice.
2) Our accounting requires Redwood's billing address and a VAT ID to be on the PO match. Can you confirm the billing legal entity and the exact company name you will appear under on invoices?
3) We also have an internal requirement to attach the AsterCloud VAT certificate when the marketplace flow uses direct seller invoicing. I attached our standard PO template — please confirm any fields you need filled.

If it's easier, loop in someone from your finance or marketplace team and we can do a short call.

Best,
Marlene
Head of Procurement, AsterCloud

Attachments: purchase_order_template.xlsx
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Marlene Koop <marlene@astercloud.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 10:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — VAT & PO questions

Hi Marlene — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below.

Summary answers:
- In most AWS SaaS marketplace flows we can be the billed seller (AWS invoices the customer) OR we can invoice AsterCloud directly if you require a standard PO invoicing flow. The distinction changes who shows on the invoice and whether your VAT handling is applied by AWS or Redwood.
- Our legal billing name for direct invoices is: Redwood Inference, Inc. (EU branch: Redwood Inference Europe B.V.). Billing address for direct invoice: Herengracht 123, 1015 BT Amsterdam, Netherlands. VAT ID (EU branch): NL999999999B01.

What I recommend:
- If AsterCloud prefers the marketplace-managed billing (AWS invoices you), we can complete the AWS private offer path — faster onboarding but AWS will be the invoice issuer (your AP desk already knows those invoices).
- If you need Redwood to appear on the invoice and to support VAT-exempt handling for intra-community B2B, we can accept a PO and invoice you directly. In that case, please attach your VAT certificate and fill the PO template.

Action items:
- Marlene: please confirm preferred billing flow (AWS-managed or Redwood direct). If direct, attach VAT cert and we will generate a direct-seller invoice PO flow.
- Van: can you confirm whether the AWS private-offer listing requires additional marketplace paperwork from our side beyond the vendor intake form?
- Ben: please prepare the vendor_intake_form_v3.pdf for AsterCloud and flag any fields that typically cause QA rework (tax form fields).

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful — otherwise reply here and we'll route accordingly.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lead, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:28:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — VAT & PO questions

Hi all — quick clarifications from marketplace ops:

- For AWS private offers (SaaS): we can publish as a "seller-managed" SaaS listing where AWS bills the customer, or as a "direct purchase" where Redwood issues invoices. The paperwork difference: seller-managed listings need completed vendor_intake_form + technical listing checklist; direct invoice flows need the vendor_intake_form + direct-billing affidavit (we have a one-page form).
- Time to activation: seller-managed usually 3–5 business days after intake is complete; direct-invoice listings add an extra 4–7 business days for finance to set up the PO/invoice mapping (depends on cross-border VAT checks).

Jonas: on the VAT nuance — if AsterCloud supplies an EU VAT certificate and claims intra-community B2B supply, we will mark the invoice as reverse-charge (no VAT) when Redwood invoices directly. But if AWS invoices AsterCloud, AWS policy applies and they may still charge VAT depending on their setup. Please confirm with your AP whether they prefer Redwood to handle reverse-charge processing or let AWS handle VAT.

Marlene — attaching the vendor_intake_form_v3.pdf for completion (see inline notes). Also attaching the direct-billing_affidavit.pdf for your legal if you opt for Redwood invoicing.

Vanessa
Marketplace Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_intake_form_v3.pdf, direct-billing_affidavit.pdf

Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 16:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — VAT & PO questions

Thanks Lauren & Vanessa — this helps. Procurement confirmed they prefer Redwood to invoice directly so we can do PO match and internal vendor reconciliation. We attached a scanned VAT certificate and our filled PO template (see attachments). A few notes from procurement/legal:

- Please ensure the invoice references the exact PO number (PO-AC-2027-619).
- For the EU reverse-charge, our legal asked that Redwood include the clause: "VAT reverse-charged under Article 194 VAT Directive" on the invoice. Can you confirm Redwood's invoicing system will accept an extra field for the tax clause?
- We will need Redwood to provide a billing contact for AP (name + email) to use if there are any remittance questions or credit hold issues.

Next steps per our side:
- EU-legal will sign the PO once Redwood confirms the invoicing clause and AP contact.
- We'll await the completed vendor intake form with the vendor ID so our AP can add Redwood to our vendor master.

Attaching: eu_vat_certificate.jpg (scanned), purchase_order_template.xlsx (filled)

Best,
Marlene
